Naked: Fair skin with sun-kissed freckles on shoulders
A small, faded raven tattoo on her left wrist
Story: Helga grew up in the harsh, beautiful fjords of Norway, learning to hunt and track from a young age. Her unparalleled skills with a bow earned her the nickname 'Raven-Eyed'. She joined the longship crew to prove her worth in battle and explore the world beyond her valley, quickly becoming an indispensable scout and skirmisher. She is fiercely independent but deeply loyal to her crew, finding her true family among her fellow shieldmaidens.
